description: Config for the standalone Renovate run in .github/workflows/renovate.yml. Automerge is enabled because the PHP base image is now pinned to an explicit release and needs automated bumps. No 'schedule' here on purpose: run timing is owned solely by the workflow cron, so this config never blocks an on-demand workflow_dispatch run. 'platformAutomerge' is off because GitHub's auto-merge queue only releases a PR once required checks pass, which would need branch protection; instead the workflow dispatches .github/workflows/validate-build.yml on each renovate/* branch (a bot push starts no workflow run, an explicit dispatch does) and Renovate merges once that check is green - usually on the following run. Note: 'comment' is not a Renovate option and would abort the entire run with a config-validation error, so annotations must live in this 'description' field.

packageRules.description: Bump the pinned PHP base image in the Dockerfile. A merged bump is published by the next image_build.yml run as a new immutable calendar version, which is what deployments then move to.

GitHub Actions updates are listed on the dependency dashboard instead of raising branches: GITHUB_TOKEN has no 'workflow' scope, so pushing a change under .github/workflows is rejected and the run would fail on every attempt. Tick an item on the dashboard only if you intend to apply that bump by hand.

bedrock/composer.json is deliberately unmanaged. Its requirements are open '>0' constraints with no committed composer.lock, so the image resolves current plugin releases through 'composer update' on every build - the weekly rebuild already picks them up and the calendar version makes that visible. Renovate has nothing to pin here and would only raise no-op noise.
